name: claudetocodex
description: ClaudeToCodex - cross-session bridge between Codex and Claude Code original sessions (Windows, one Codex with one or more Claude pairs by name, short text).

interface.shortDescription: Bridge work messages between Codex and running Claude Code sessions.
interface.longDescription: Connect this Codex session to one or more running Claude Code sessions, then send (by name with several targets), reply and follow up across sessions without the PO relaying text.
defaultPrompt: Connect one or more running Claude sessions by name and send a work message.
